subject: BrightLeaf launch: temporary ingress guardrail and quota exception
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: BrightLeaf launch: temporary ingress guardrail and quota exception

Team —

BrightLeaf (contact: Priya Shah) confirmed a public beta activation on 2027-06-02 with expected peak requests as they ramp their marketing. They asked for a short-term bump to their ingress quota and a temporary higher rate-limit for 72 hours around launch to avoid early dropouts.

I attached their day-by-day forecast (see attachment) and created a short list of asks so we can move quickly:

- Can infra provide a temporary quota + rate-limit increase for account DL-2027-019 (60% above baseline) from 06/02 00:00 UTC through 06/04 23:59 UTC?
- Engineering: proposed fallback variants and routing if we hit capacity: can we pin a smaller quantized model for their trial tier?
- Product/Policy: any compliance gating (data residency, audit logging) we need to turn on for the temporary window?
- Sales/Ops: confirm contract amendment & overage handling (Priya said legal would sign a short DocuSign amendment).

Attachments: [Attachment: brightleaf_traffic_forecast.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)]

I want to align owners and an approval path by EOD so we can notify the customer and update runbooks.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf launch: temporary ingress guardrail and quota exception

Stephanie —

Thanks for the head's up and the forecast. I reviewed the attached sheet and summarized impact/risk below:

Summary findings:
- Forecast peak RPS: ~420 (10-min sustained windows) on day 1, ramping to ~620 on day 2 peak bursts.
- Baseline tenant capacity currently supports ~300 RPS comfortably; 60% uplift will push one of our edge pools near 85% utilization in the worst window.

Immediate mitigations I recommend:
- Short-term quota bump scoped to two specific pools (us-west and us-east) rather than global to limit blast radius.
- Canary the bump: route 10% of traffic to the bumped pool for the first 30 minutes, monitor token-level latency and error rates, then increase to 50% if metrics stable.
- Fallback: pin a 3-bit quantized variant for trial tier to reduce GPU memory and increase throughput; quality tradeoff documented in playbook.
- KV cache priming: we can pre-warm common prompts mentioned in the forecast to reduce early cold-start token cost.

I attached an updated excerpt from the capacity playbook with the canary checklist. If ops approves, I can prep the scaling policy and pre-warm scripts by EOD 05/31.

Attachments: [Attachment: capacity_playbook_v2.pdf (pdf, 185KB)]

- Marcus (Infra)
From: Priya Shah <priya@brightleaf.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightLeaf Legal <legal@brightleaf.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf launch: temporary ingress guardrail and quota exception

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the rapid coordination. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Peak concurrency: our product analytics shows expected concurrent sessions of ~480 during the paid trial prompt blast (this maps roughly to Marcus' higher end).
- Ramp pattern: we will do a staged announcement, please plan for two spikes (06/02 09:00-10:30 PT and 06/03 14:00-15:30 PT).
- Legal: we will sign a short amendment to cover the temporary uplift and an overage estimate; sending DocuSign shortly.

Also: can you confirm whether request sampling or detailed per-request logs will be available for our team during the window? That will help our SREs correlate errors.

Thanks —
Priya Shah
Head of Platform, BrightLeaf AI
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@brightleaf.ai>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-31T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf launch: temporary ingress guardrail and quota exception

Priya / team —

Updated plan after infra review and legal note:

Action summary (owners):
- Marcus: implement scoped pool bump & canary policy (10% -> 50%) and pre-warm KV cache (due 06/01 16:00 PT).
- Laura: ops runbook update and on-call rotation for the launch window (due 06/01 20:00 PT).
- Karthik: coordinate contract amendment notification and temporary overage credit approval with finance.
- Stephanie: customer communications (pre-launch checklist + monitoring links).

We will enable request sampling (configurable to 1% default) and a 48-hour extended logs retention window for the BrightLeaf trial so their SREs can debug. Marcus: will that be sufficient?

DocuSign: Priya, we received the amendment link this morning (no-reply@docusign.com). We will countersign on receipt of the signed amendment.

If there are no blockers, I propose we mark this approved internally and notify the customer by 06/01 10:00 PT.

Thanks —
Stephanie
